items.t: Planet Labs: Waiting On The Next Sovereign Satellite Deal
items.sum: Planet Labs' backlog fell to $815 million in Q2, while its portion due within 12 months rose to roughly 50%, supporting near-term revenue visibility.

items.t: How Big Could Planet Labs Stock's Next Fall Be?
items.sum: Planet Labs PBC closed at $10.64 on Tuesday, November 24. That is 79.3% below its highest close of the past year. It lost 22.7% in the month to November 24, with no new results since September 3.

items.t: Planet Labs Stock Nears 52-Week Low - Here's Why
